defects_exposed: low/base/high fee band mislabeled as bound
initial_v4_1_red_run.incidental_green_limitation: The off-grid complement mutation was rejected only by an unrelated complement-identity mismatch; V4.1 adds an independent tapered-grid gate.

official_exchange_sources.title: Fee rounding
official_exchange_sources.locked_use: Every true fill has rounded trade fee and account-balance rounding; fee accumulation and whole-cent rebates are per order. V4.1 never treats maker trade-fee multiplier zero as proof that total net rounding fee is zero.

official_exchange_sources.title: Fixed-point migration
official_exchange_sources.locked_use: Contract counts accept two decimals with minimum granularity delta=0.01 contracts; market price grids come from price_level_structure/price_ranges. The tapered_deci_cent example has 0.001 ticks outside 0.10-0.90 and 0.01 ticks inside.

official_exchange_sources.title: Market settlement
official_exchange_sources.locked_use: Settlement normally occurs after expiration, timing varies, finalized positions resolve automatically, and funds transfer at settlement. Scheduled close is not a cash-release receipt.

official_exchange_sources.title: Order directions
official_exchange_sources.locked_use: Held YES exits through ASK/sell YES; held NO exits through BID/buy YES.

official_exchange_sources.title: Kalshi Fee Schedule
official_exchange_sources.locked_use: The authenticated existing local PDF gives general taker rate 0.07/default M=1, maker rate 0.0175/default M=0, centicent rounding, and no settlement fee. KXBTC15M is absent from the non-standard list and therefore inherits the defaults. Maker trade-fee M=0 does not by itself prove zero balance-rounding fee.

current_open_event_get.observation_limit: Field absence is not standalone fee proof; series, historical fee changes, and authenticated PDF must agree.

external_source_receipts.drift_rule: Any PDF path/size/mtime/raw hash/xattr/page/text drift, series fee field drift, nonempty fee_changes response, or market grid drift fails closed before candidate use.

target_account_precision_receipt.locked_use: Account-precision evidence only. It is not a discovery execution, reward, action, or fitting row.

market_and_data_boundary.ticker_binding: market_ticker, market_id, source_date_utc, market-window open/close, metadata stable id, and metadata source hash must agree
market_and_data_boundary.primary_candidate_maker_quote_gate: whole-cent aligned only; tapered subcent maker quotes are sensitivity-only

historical_public_proxy_evidence.strict_full_proxy_rule: Public trade fields are taker direction on the YES-book price scale. A resting YES BID is crossed by taker NO/ASK at a strictly lower YES price; a resting NO bid is a YES-book ASK and is crossed by taker YES/BID at a strictly higher YES price. Derived cumulative child-row quantity must cover the complete maker order.
historical_public_proxy_evidence.summary_derivation: Trade indices are contiguous and causal; trigger id/envelope is the final child row; cumulative quantity and spine hash are derived from normalized child rows rather than trusted from the summary.
historical_public_proxy_evidence.first_fill_receipt_binding: Evidence wall, monotonic, ingest sequence, stable id, ticker, and market id equal the first-fill envelope.
historical_public_proxy_evidence.continuous_complement_binding: Evidence equals the terminal complement receipt and terminal occurs strictly before market close.
historical_public_proxy_evidence.race_binding: CANCEL_RACE_PAIR references the same normalized complement evidence id and occurs strictly before cancel effective x.
historical_public_proxy_evidence.zero_atom_binding: First and complement share wall/mono envelope; complement ingest_sequence is strictly greater.

cancel_and_fok_clock.public_book_cutoff: recv_mono_ns must be strictly less than cancel/FOK effective recv_mono_ns; wall is also strictly earlier

fok_book_and_slice_spine.sequence_rule: contiguous zero-based slice_index in canonical best-to-worse order
fok_book_and_slice_spine.execution_rule: Contract walks source_qty_fp and derives executed_qty_fp; caller-supplied execution slices are forbidden.
fok_book_and_slice_spine.atomicity: FOK_FULL if canonical source depth reaches q, otherwise FOK_ZERO with every executed_qty_fp=0
fok_book_and_slice_spine.candidate_grid_gate: Every source and limit price is legal tapered_deci_cent and whole-cent aligned for the primary candidate arm.

symbols.h: 0.0001 USD target DIRECT account balance precision
symbols.q_i: derived executed quantity at level i
symbols.rho_k_i: signed-balance remainder in [0,h) for a k*delta_qty true fill

fee_contract.forward_actual_fee: Use the actual fee_cost receipt later; historical public L2 marks it unavailable.
fee_contract.maker_primary_alignment_proof: With whole-cent p, delta_qty=0.01 and target DIRECT h=tau=0.0001, p*delta_qty and every rounded trade fee are h-aligned; every legal private maker partition has rho=0.

p_0_30_q_2_test_vector.conclusion: The V4 0.03 high scenario was not an upper bound.

symbols.R: q*pc+Fc_upper; local engineering reserve for an independently fillable resting complement, not an exchange-held-cash claim
symbols.x: synthetic cancel-effective or order-expiry receipt elapsed seconds

capital_and_cash_contract.reservation_release_order: R is added back only after synthetic cancel effective x
capital_and_cash_contract.hard_release_rule: x is the sealed post-close synthetic public-lifecycle order-expiry/cancel-effective scenario; r is the actual public settlement receipt. Neither is silently backfilled to scheduled close.
capital_and_cash_contract.settlement_constraint: r >= market close and public receipt ticker, market id, status, result, stable id, source hash, receive wall/mono, determined time, and finalized time are bound

ddl_and_commit_authority.transaction_rule: Insert all eleven tables, execute normative validator, roll back all rows on any violation.
